CHAPTER VIII DIVISION OF HUMAN TYPES BY EIGHT Who are the four persons identiﬁable with the path and who are the four identiﬁable with the fruition? The stream-attainer and one who proceeds to realise the fruition stage; the once-returner and one who proceeds to realise the fruition stage; the never-returner and one who proceeds to realise the fruition stage; and the Arahant (elect or worthy) and one who proceeds to attain Arahantship—these are the four persons who are identiﬁable with the path and these the four iden- tiﬁable with the fruition. Here ends the speciﬁcation of grouping by Eight.
